findings.issue: Subscriber eviction left the HTTP handler blocked indefinitely on a stalled socket.
findings.disposition: Fixed with the existing server write budget applied per frame. An independent TCP probe observed handler termination while the client socket stayed open.

findings.issue: SQLite WAL files could race temporary directory removal after a live-stream test.
findings.disposition: Fixed by draining the closed reader pool before writer and directory cleanup. Repeated race-enabled tests passed.
